whatIs: Lemon Squeezy is a payments platform for selling software and digital products that acts as the merchant of record: it handles payment collection, fraud, and sales taxes. It covers subscriptions, free trials, license keys, secure download links, no-code checkout, affiliates, and metrics such as MRR and churn, plus a REST API and webhooks.
It's a good fit when you sell a SaaS or digital products to customers in several countries and don't want to handle taxes and invoicing yourself.
uses: Charging for SaaS subscriptions, with plan changes and failed-payment recovery.
Selling a template or a course with a protected download link.
Issuing and validating license keys for a desktop app from your backend using the API.
caveats: It charges a fee on every transaction, and there may be additional charges, for example on payments from outside the United States.
Because it's the merchant of record, the seller your customer sees is Lemon Squeezy (Link, LLC), not your company; check how that fits with your invoicing.

Stripe acquired Lemon Squeezy in 2024 and is moving its users to Stripe Managed Payments; the team itself acknowledges slower support and fewer new features, so evaluate the service's future before integrating it.
pricingNote: No monthly fee: 5% + $0.50 per transaction, with possible extra charges outside the United States.
idealFor: Independent developers selling software or digital products worldwide.
